commit 0b1da6b3a5a8c385941c53b89c60cc6f83a5b912
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 30 22:58:16 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 30 22:58:16 2024 +0000

    Bug 1691802 - mozconfig files for Thunderbird win64-aarch64 builds. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D95554

diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-opt b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-opt
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..5a64b8d64a0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-opt
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+# This file is sourced by the nightly and release mozconfigs.
+
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/common"
+
+ac_add_options --enable-update-channel=${MOZ_UPDATE_CHANNEL}
+
+# Needed to enable breakpad in application.ini
+export MOZILLA_OFFICIAL=1
+
+# Package js shell.
+export MOZ_PACKAGE_JSSHELL=1
diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64 b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..8ef4b4d0e35
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+# This file is used by all AArch64 Win64 builds
+
+ac_add_options --target=aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
+
+. $topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.clang-cl
+
+if test `uname -s` = Linux; then
+
+# Configure expects executables for check_prog, so set the relevant files
+# as executable on the first evaluation of the mozconfig where they exist.
+export UPX="${MOZ_FETCHES_DIR}/upx-3.95-win64/upx.exe"
+if [ -f "${UPX}" ]; then
+    chmod +x "${UPX}"
+fi
+
+fi
+
+if test -n "$USE_ARTIFACT"; then
+ac_add_options --disable-mapi
+fi
diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/debug b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/debug
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..b945df91b8d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/debug
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/build/mozconfig.comm-sccache"
+. "$topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.win-common"
+. "$topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.common"
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64"
+
+ac_add_options --enable-debug
+
+# Needed to enable breakpad in application.ini
+export MOZILLA_OFFICIAL=1
+
+# Package js shell
+export MOZ_PACKAGE_JSSHELL=1
+
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/common"
diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/l10n-mozconfig b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/l10n-mozconfig
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..896331a96eb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/l10n-mozconfig
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64"
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/l10n-common"
diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/nightly b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/nightly
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..a8795e3ab35
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/nightly
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/build/mozconfig.comm-sccache"
+. "$topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.win-common"
+. "$topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.common"
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64"
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-opt"
+
+ac_add_options --with-branding=comm/mail/branding/nightly
+
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/common"
+
diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/release b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/release
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..6a5628e43dc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/release
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+. "$topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.win-common"
+. "$topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.common"
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64"
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-opt"
+
+ac_add_options --enable-official-branding
+
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/common"
